除了 AirPods Pro 3 持續減價 $50 之外，今日 9to5Toys 午間快報嘅焦點仲有鈦金屬 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 減 $184、鋁金屬 Cell 型號減 $130，以及更多由 $299 起嘅優惠。罕見嘅 Apple 鍵盤同黑色 Magic Mouse 優惠（竟然）仍然有效，我哋亦有我個人至愛嘅 Anker Prime 流動充電器（兼具牆插充電器功能）提供折扣優惠，但今日真正嘅配件焦點係 Nomad 嘅大型週年紀念全站大減價，提供 MagSafe 充電器、保護殼、Find My 追蹤卡、Apple Watch 錶帶等罕見優惠。詳情請繼續睇落去。

Now you can grab the new AirPods Pro 3 for nearly $50 off just in time for summer, with more deals from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 $249
  • AirPods 4 $99 $129
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $149 $179

Back in stock: Amazon takes $184 off the titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11

This deal sold out in a flash yesterday, so if you're interested you really don't want to miss it today. The Apple 46mm GPS + Cell Series 11 with Slate titanium case is once again down to $564.97 at Amazon, a $184 discount.

Amazon is now shipping the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell model in Slate titanium with a black sport band for $564.97 with free shipping.

This is one of the premier titanium case models, priced at $749. You can grab one for $184 below its going rate during today's (likely short-lived) discount, which is one of the better prices we've tracked on this model. It did dip as low as $550 very briefly before Prime Day last month, but aside from that, this is the best offer we've tracked on this configuration.

Again, this deal is only for those who like the titanium build and Slate colorway, because even with the discount, you're still paying quite a bit. That said, the more popular aluminum models in the Series 11 lineup are also seeing $100 and $130 markdowns this week:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 $399
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 $429
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 $499
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 $529

Rare Apple Keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals (still) going strong at new all-time lows from $80

We certainly see plenty of deals on mainstream Apple gear – AirPods Pro 3 are $50 off, and the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models are still up to $130 off right now – but the Magic accessories are rarer to see. However, we're (still) seeing the Prime Day discounts carry over onto the base Magic Keyboard, the full-size model with Touch ID, and the black Apple Magic Mouse.

Ahead of these extended Prime Day discounts, deals on these Apple accessories are very rare, and how long these offers will last is anyone's guess.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $80 $99
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $80 $99
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID (Full-size) $145 $179

All three are the lowest prices we've ever tracked on Amazon. It's been a very long time since we've seen the black Apple Magic Mouse fall this low (I'm tempted to pick up a backup for myself), while both Magic Keyboard models are at new all-time lows – the base model only hit this price once before, and we've never seen the Touch ID version below $158.

If you're looking to switch up your Apple Magic input setup, now while Prime Day pricing is still live might be the best time to do it.

Nomad's big anniversary sitewide sale officially live: rare deals on MagSafe chargers, cases, Apple Watch bands, and more

Nomad's metal and glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands get rare 20% discounts

There are plenty of more affordable 25W Qi2 MagSafe stands out there, but very few are as premium and beautiful as Nomad's latest. They aren't cheap, but now that the brand's 2026 anniversary sale is officially live, we're tracking rare discounts on both the 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models for your entire Apple everyday carry.

Nomad's 2026 anniversary sale is officially live, with tons of discounts on its iPhone 17 cases, wallets, Apple Watch bands, and other charging accessories, but the Stand One and Stand One Max deals are some of the rarest:

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One $103 $129
  • Nomad 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max $135 $169

What you're looking at here is Nomad's newest generation of 25W Qi2 MagSafe stands. They're 20% off right now, which might not sound like a lot, but these almost never see discounts.

We're talking about a premium solid and seriously hefty metal construction, with a glass finish for an elegant and luxurious home for your Apple gear.

The one catch with this sale is that the brand-new Cosmic Orange colorways aren't included:

Rare discounts on Nomad's Tracking Card: Apple Find My Pro models, Cosmic Orange, Google Find Hub, more

Nomad's anniversary sale is officially live, and while there were a few hiccups with the Tracking Card Pro and Air deals earlier on, they're now live and shipping. The discounts aren't massive, but we're talking about rare price drops, with Apple Find My and Google Find Hub versions starting from $32.

Nomad's Tracking Card is easily one of the best options out there and comes with wireless MagSafe charging – I never leave the house without mine:

  • Tracking Card Air $32 $35 Apple Find My or Google Find Hub
  • Tracking Card Pro $41 $45 All three colors

Nomad's Titanium Stratos Apple Watch bands are 20% off (rare) during the brand's anniversary sale

My favorite Anker Prime power bank with a display (that doubles as a wall charger) is back at its $70 summer deal price

Anker's 2026 summer sale is still going strong, with fresh discounts across the brand's latest Prime charging gear, power banks, desktop chargers, 25W MagSafe stands, and more. One of my personal favorites from the brand's portable charging lineup is also back at its $69.99 2026 low – the 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank, which also doubles as a wall charger.

The 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank is now shipping on Amazon for $69.99 with free shipping. Originally priced as much as $90, we've tracked this deal a few times this year, but I wanted to make sure you didn't miss it this week because it's been one of the most useful pieces of portable charging gear in my kit for nearly a year now.

The brand's newer lineup certainly has more powerful power banks with bigger battery capacity and faster charging output, but this one is super useful to me. It's one of the more compact options out there, easily slipping into my everyday carry, while still providing a built-in smart display, USB-C connectivity, and enough juice to handle a day or more out and about.

Check out my hands-on review here.

It's also one of the few models in the lineup that doubles as a wall charger. There are foldable outlet prongs on the back of the power bank, so you can charge the internal battery while also using it as a wall charger – I really love this design that saves you from having to carry an extra piece of gear just to charge it up.

Still live: Anker's 3-port 160W charger with smart display is back at Prime Day pricing (33% off), more from $8

Alongside ongoing deals on Anker's display-equipped Qi2 25W smart charger and its newest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging station, we're also tracking its 3-port Prime charger with a 160W display back at Prime Day pricing (a 33% discount).

Amazon's official Anker storefront is now shipping the Smart Display 3-Port Prime Charger for $99.99 with free shipping.

For something that's essentially just a wall charger, the price isn't cheap, but we're talking about a charger with a built-in Smart Display that delivers up to 160W of power in a form factor that is "the same size as the AirPods Pro 3 case, making it compact enough to take on the go while still being powerful enough for your devices."

More specifically, it can deliver up to 140W from a single USB-C port, capable of "charging a 16-inch MacBook Pro from 0% to 50% in just 25 minutes."

As for the Smart Display, it features AnkerSense View technology that lets you "monitor power in real-time on the screen, instantly switch modes, and unlock custom modes via the app over Bluetooth."
